name: game-factory
description: Casual Game Factory: one shared engine, many data-driven games.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p engine/schemas && tsc -p engine/core && tsc -p engine/mechanics/associations && tsc -p engine/mechanics/tripeaks && tsc -p tools && tsc -p tests && tsc -p engine/app
scripts.dev: npm run app:select && npm --workspace @gf/app run start
scripts.web: npm run app:select && npm --workspace @gf/app run web
scripts.export:web: npm run app:select && cd engine/app && npx expo export --platform web --output-dir ../../build/web/${GAME_ID:-maplebrook}
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && tsx tools/src/cli.ts validate --all --deep
